subsystem_tray_chassis_recycled_asa.structural_purpose: Industrial retail display chassis. Sliced at a rugged 0.24mm layer height to increase print farm turnaround speed. High nozzle temperatures merge the post-consumer recycled ASA chains into a durable, shock-resistant block capable of withstanding heavy daily commercial shelf cleaning, intense counter drops, and isopropyl alcohol disinfection runs.

subsystem_branding_badge_metallic_petg.structural_purpose: High-fidelity quick-swap branding badges. Sliced at a fine 0.16mm layer boundary with a 100% dense solid infill layout. This forces a perfectly flat, razor-sharp finish across multi-color graphic shifts, making the embossed corporate logos pop with crisp, professional definition underneath bright showroom dispensary spotlights.
